findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 22px at 1440px. Widest offenders: img (+22px), img (+22px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The sheet dealt Barlow Condensed and Barlow, but the page renders Public Sans, Newsreader.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 12px at 768px. Widest offenders: img (+12px), img (+12px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 348px of the width empty: "Understand it before it binds you.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
